text:
Maya: Heads-up — Summit Trust wants to run a week-long POC starting next Tuesday. Main blockers they've called out: corporate SSO (SAML), SCIM for 1M users with daily deltas, strict RBAC by OU, and domain-proof + tenant lock. They also asked about Dedicated vs Private pricing and audit log retention. @Arjun can you confirm SCIM throughput and recommended seed/delta approach?

Arjun: I can take this. Short answers: hosted SCIM handles ~500 req/s/customer by default; for a 1M user initial seed we recommend using the bulk import endpoint (one-time) + SCIM PATCH for daily deltas. For sustained high-rate syncs we suggest rate-limited parallelism and a backoff strategy. Example PATCH skeleton we give customers:
```json
{
  "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations":[{
    "op":"replace",
    "path":"members",
    "value":[{"value":"user-1234","displayName":"Alice Example"}]
  }]
}
```
Tested IdPs: Okta and Azure AD (both fine). OneLogin should work but less exercised internally. For mapping: SCIM groups -> RBAC role mapping supported out of the box.

Priya: Security checklist notes: we need SAML metadata exchange (IdP metadata + SP metadata), assert signature validation, SAML clock skew tolerances, and clear guidance on SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated flows. For SCIM security we require: scoped SCIM tokens, rotation guidance, optional mTLS for Private, and IP allowlist support. Audit logs: hosted = 30 days by default, Dedicated = configurable (can do 90 days+ as an add-on), Private = customer-controlled retention. Also confirm AES-256 at rest + KMS for keys.

Leo: Pricing/ops quick note: for a short POC we can spin up a temporary Dedicated slice for 2 weeks (estimated infra addon $1200/day) + a one-time SCIM seed job fee (approx $2k). Private has a minimum contract and ~3–4 week lead time for deployment. I'll pull final commercial numbers from finance and post here by EOD.

Maya: They specifically asked about domain controls: no self-signup, domain-locked tenant creation, and domain ownership proofing. Can we support automatic tenant mapping based on verified domains?

Arjun: Yes — we support domain verification via DNS TXT records and then domain lock enforcement (preventing ad-hoc tenant creation). We can optionally auto-map authenticated emails to an existing tenant if the domain is verified. Also support claim mapping from SAML assertion -> group attributes -> RBAC roles. We'll need to provide their IdP attribute mapping template.

Priya: For compliance, add: exportable audit trail for user lifecycle events (create/update/delete), SCIM provisioning events, and SAML auth events. For Private deployments we can enable longer-term archival into customer's S3. Also recommend we require SCIM token rotation every 90 days and recommend using short-lived tokens where possible.

Maya: Great. I'll assemble a one-pager for the RFP and include the recommended seed+delta flow, security controls, and RBAC mapping examples. @Leo can you confirm POC pricing + a proposed timeline by EOD? Also scheduling request: need a technical kickoff with Summit infra and their IdP engineer.

calendar-bot: Created event "Summit Trust POC kickoff" Tue 2026-04-07 09:30 — invites sent to Maya, Arjun, Priya, Leo, summit-infra.

Maya: Thanks all — Summit also asked for a rollback plan for the SCIM seed (they're paranoid about accidental deletes). I'll add our safe-seed checklist and ask engineering to include a dry-run mode for the import. :thumbsup:
